market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI $140 HIGH by end of June from current $108. Need +$32 in 2 months. Requires significant escalation - direct military conflict, Strait of Hormuz disruption. Tail event but Iran tensions make it conceivable. ~0.15-0.20.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severity of Middle East conflict; $140 requires more than headline tension.
